tense: past tense for assessment activities and findings of the review period (for example 'was assessed', 'was reviewed', 'found')
sentence_style: short declarative sentences in formal prose, typically one to two sentences per section introducing a metrics table
phrasing_conventions: Passive constructions describe assessment activity (for example 'Multi-factor authentication coverage was assessed')
Section prose is followed by a Metric/Value table
Metric names are noun phrases such as 'MFA coverage' and 'Managed devices'
formatting_conventions: H2 headings for each major section, in order: Identity Security, Device Security
Each H2 section contains short prose followed by a two-column pipe table with header 'Metric | Value'
Percentages are written with a percent sign (for example 90%)
Counts are written as plain integers (for example 10)
banned_patterns: first-person voice (I, we, our), as the prior report is written in third person and the style-profile schema names first-person as an example banned pattern
